Usage: gacli report funnel [options]

Run a GA4 funnel report

Options:
  --steps <json>                  Funnel steps as a JSON string of FunnelStep[]
  --open-funnel                   Use an open funnel (users can enter at any
                                  step)
  --funnel-breakdown <dimension>  Dimension name to break down the funnel by
  --start-date <date>             Start date for the report (default:
                                  "7daysAgo")
  --end-date <date>               End date for the report (default: "today")
  -h, --help                      display help for command
